sources.title: qwen3.5-plus model information
sources.evidence: Exact alias documentation, updated October 11, 2026, maps it to qwen3.5-plus-2026-02-15 and specifies hybrid linear attention/sparse MoE, text/image/video inputs, text output, function calling and a 1,000,000-token context. It lists the April snapshot separately. Documentation access does not establish live inference operation.

sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: Official release tables explicitly date qwen3.5-plus and its February snapshot to February 15, 2026 across the International, Global and Beijing entries. The April 20 snapshot has its own April 23 release entry.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-397B-A17B model card
sources.evidence: Explicitly identifies Qwen3.5-Plus as the corresponding hosted version with extra production features. Its Language Model subsection reports nominal 397B total and 17B activated parameters. The Apache-2.0 license is for the downloadable checkpoint, not a separately established license for the hosted alias.

sources.title: Deep thinking
sources.evidence: Under Qwen3.5 Commercial Edition, explicitly lists qwen3.5-plus and qwen3.5-plus-2026-02-15 as hybrid-thinking models with thinking enabled by default.

sources.title: Alibaba Open-Sources Qwen3.5, A Natively Multimodal Model Built For High-Efficiency Inference
sources.evidence: February 16, 2026 corporate announcement identifies Alibaba as the developer and describes Qwen3.5-397B-A17B as also named Qwen3.5-Plus. This announcement follows the hosted-release date in the API release log.

name.note: Preserves the catalog's space-normalized form of official Qwen3.5-Plus.

developer.note: Alibaba Group's announcement explicitly identifies the model as its release.

family.note: The exact alias is listed within the Qwen3.5 series.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit hosted-release date in the official API log, not inferred from the snapshot suffix. The corporate announcement is dated February 16; the April snapshot is a later separate release.

open_weights.note: Qwen explicitly identifies this API model as the hosted version of the linked released checkpoint. Open weights refers to that mapped model, not the service implementation.

license.note: License of the explicitly corresponding released checkpoint; hosted service terms remain separate.

parameters_b.note: Nominal language-decoder billions, supported through Qwen's explicit hosted-counterpart mapping and documented February alias snapshot. Requires the proposed language_decoder scope; complete hosted-deployment count remains undisclosed.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal activated language-decoder billions under the same mapping. This excludes any unreported vision-processing or deployment-specific contribution.

architecture.note: The exact hosted model is explicitly documented as sparse MoE combined with linear attention.

context_window.note: Exact alias context limit in tokens; distinct from maximum input length.

modalities.note: All listed service regions agree on these input and output modalities.

reasoning.note: Exact alias supports hybrid thinking, enabled by default and controllable per request.

tool_call.note: Function calling is explicitly supported for the exact alias.

description.value: Hosted Qwen3.5 vision-language model with hybrid linear attention and sparse MoE, a one-million-token context, optional thinking, and function calling.
description.note: Replaces broad task positioning with directly documented hosted capabilities.

patch.description: Hosted Qwen3.5 vision-language model with hybrid linear attention and sparse MoE, a one-million-token context, optional thinking, and function calling.

sources.label: Official hosted-counterpart mapping and decoder counts

patch.notes: 397B total and 17B active describe the language decoder of Qwen’s explicitly corresponding released model. The complete hosted deployment total is undisclosed. The documented alias maps to the 2026-02-15 snapshot. Open weights and Apache-2.0 refer to the corresponding checkpoint; hosted service terms are separate.

summary: Confirms the official hosted-checkpoint mapping and its open weights/Apache-2.0 license. Adds nominal 397B/17B language-decoder counts and documented MoE architecture. Release, context, modalities, reasoning and tools are independently checked; deployment-specific full tensor total remains undisclosed.
